body.x: Hans Vestberg Verizon was chosen as the keynote speaker at CES 2019. Hans Vestberg's keynote will be held at the Venetian Palazzo Ballroom in Las Vegas on Tuesday, January 8, 2019 at 4:00 pm.
5G offers unlimited possibilities for newservices and applications in a changing industry, with a high data rate and lowlatency that is 100 times faster than ever before.

Verizon is the first company in the world tooffer commercial 5G broadband Internet services and is looking for futureconnectivity through 5G by developing new technologies and services thatharmonize the physical and digital worlds. Hans Vestberg will speak at a CESkeynote addressing how to improve smart urban infrastructure and the impact of5G to change the world.

Verizon also focuses on delivering seamless services for its customers through its network assets. Verizon's service comprises the largest 4G LTE network in the United States, the world's first commercial-generation broadband Internet service, and a residential fiber network. Verizon will showcase its latest products and services, including this service, at CES 2019.

"Verizon will demonstrate 5G to improvethe quality of life for people around the world," said Gary Shapiro,President and CEO of CTA. "Only at CES can we see the impact of 5Gthroughout the industry, and also hear the opinions of industry experts."
He also said, "we welcome and wait forHans Vestberg's keynote speech." “We look forward to the future ofVerizon, spurring new markets, creating new jobs and connecting communitiesaround the world."

Hans Vestberg has served as Chief TechnologyOfficer (CTO) and president of Global Networks, and has served as president andCEO of Ericsson, a Swedish communications equipment manufacturer, for sixyears. Vestberg has had a keynote speech at CES when he was CEO of Ericsson.

Meanwhile, 'CES', the largest IT exhibitionin the world, is an exhibition that can grasp the trend of the global consumerelectronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by the American ConsumerTechnology Association (CTA) and is held every January. A global news networkthat most recently reported the issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's topthree tech exhibitions over the last twelve years, has sent a special reportteam to CES this year to report major issues in the world market, I introduceto the world.

On the other hand, AVING NEWS, the media company that is most passionate about advertising Korean companies in the world, is planning to launch the CES 2019 start-up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT as a project to help domestic start-ups to advance into the global market. Considering the advantages of CES, which is not a traditional joint venture, it plans to expose promising start-ups to investors, businesses and media through a variety of programs including participation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networking parties. Particularly, on the third evening of the exhibition, the company plans to hold a 'MIK NIGHT' party, a business networking party, inviting investors and media that companies have met. MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT is jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and Global MICE Expert Group, GMEG.
